title: What did the wallet spend in USDr?
alt: One Rayls receipt: 3.356290 USDr Value, 10.068869 USDr across four transfer logs, and 2.603706 USDr wallet debit after refund and gas.

title: Follow the USDr refund
alt: Caller sends 3.356290 USDr to CreditMessaging, which forwards it to EndpointV2. EndpointV2 sends 2.581761 to the send library and refunds 0.774528 to the caller. Adding 0.021944 gas produces a wallet debit of 2.603706 USDr.
placement: After: How did 3.356290 USDr become a 2.603706 USDr debit?

title: What moved in the receipt?
alt: A four-USDr native send is reflected in both Value and one log. At zero Value, observed examples include a 0.03 USDr direct transfer, a swap credit, a gas-only approval, and a local gas funding mint.
placement: After: What can move when the Value field is zero?

title: How far did the check go?
alt: 23 original calls from one sending wallet reconciled, and four original direct wallet balance pairs matched. A separate follow-up added eight exact balance pairs on two later same-route calls and four exact fee debits from four different zero-Value payers.
placement: After: Which balance evidence was available?
